Name: Roosters (blue chicken replacers)
Author: Zhuria
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla adult blue chickens with either white or brown roosters that fit in seamlessly with your vanilla white and brown hens.

Now includes blue roosters in two options - purple or red combs.
